messages:
anya-support: Heads-up: AcmeReports reporting repeated 503s and placement denials hitting their Dedicated pool `na-east-prod-1` for ~8m. They saw 429s then 503, customer-facing impact. Pushing here so infra can triage. :rotating_light:

sarah.ops: on it, grabbing logs and allocator traces. Do we have an autoscaler event around 12:31 UTC? :eyes:

mike-infra: I can see a burst of allocations from a single tenant around 12:28-12:34 UTC. GPU util spiked to 98% for ~90s, then cluster started redispatching / draining nodes. Looks like autoscaler interpreted idle bucket afterwards and triggered a downscale step right as demand moved — caused placement denials for new requests.

raj-alloc: allocator log snippet (na-east-prod-1):
```
2026-03-17T12:30:45Z WARN placement: allocation_request tenant=acct-8345 model=text-gen-v1 batch=large
2026-03-17T12:31:16Z ERROR placement: allocate failed capacity=0 err=insufficient_devices
2026-03-17T12:31:17Z INFO placement: requeue request id=req-9af3 ttl=15s
2026-03-17T12:32:03Z ERROR http: upstream response status=503 X-Alloc-Status=denied
```

alloc-bot: autoscaler event: pool=na-east-prod-1 action=scale_down reason=idle_gpu_window threshold=0.12 time=2026-03-17T12:31:00Z triggered_by=policy-idle-window-30m

anya-support: Customer observed auth token occasionally 401 on retries — probably because their client retries with stale tokens while placement loop errors happening. They pasted this curl output:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/na-east-prod-1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
# -> x-request-id: r-abc-123
```

mike-infra: hypothesis: noisy tenant ran a large batched job that saturated GPU memory, OOMs triggered eviction, autoscaler saw oscillating metrics (spike then below-threshold) and did a scale-down step mid-redispatch. That left insufficient free devices for placements -> 503s. Also routing retries caused some auth/timeouts upstream.

anya-support: Customer asks for immediate mitigation and credits. Suggested short-term: route their traffic to na-west fallback or enable a per-tenant soft-reserve.

sarah.ops: Immediate actions taken: 1) applied emergency priority cap on noisy tenant (acct-8345) to reduce concurrent heavy batches; 2) forced a +2 GPU emergency add to na-east reserve (manual hot-add); 3) enabled route override for AcmeReports to na-west fallback pool. All changes deployed at 12:38 UTC.

raj-alloc: After the cap + hot-add we see placement success rate back to normal ~12:40 UTC. Repro steps I used to reproduce locally:
1) Spawn 6 parallel large-batch jobs against na-east-prod-1 with batch_size=1024 and concurrency=4.
2) Observe GPU mem pressure -> eviction logs and allocate failures.
3) Force autoscaler policy eval window to 30s to replicate mis-trigger.

mike-infra: Long-term fixes proposed: adjust autoscaler hysteresis (longer cooldown), change idle detection to be weighted by recent peak, and add per-tenant burst isolation (soft quotas / backpressure). Also add better leader coordination so downscale doesn't start while rebalancing.

anya-support: Customer note: they saw 401 spikes but accepted temporary route to na-west. They asked for a formal RCA and credit.

kevin-cust: Thanks for fast response. Can you confirm exact window of impact for billing adjustments? We saw ~7 minutes of failed requests and some retries that counted toward token usage.

anya-support: we'll collate request logs (r-abc-123 and others), estimate failed vs succeeded token charges, and follow up with accounting. I'll escalate to accounts for credit.

raj-alloc: action items tracked: INC-2026-8345 create postmortem, add autoscaler policy change to eng-runtime sprint, implement per-tenant burst caps, and add alerting for concurrent heavy-batch tenants.

sarah.ops: tagging PM and runtime leads for RCA: @mike-infra @raj-alloc — please own follow-ups. Also cc @billing-team for customer credit flow.

mike-infra: I’ll open a PR with autoscaler hysteresis changes and a canary to test in staging first.

anya-support: I'll send AcmeReports a short incident summary + temporary credit offer and mark as P1 until RCA finished.

kevin-cust: Appreciate it, please keep me posted. :thumbsup:

sarah.ops: closing slack triage for now — system stable, routing in place. Will paste the postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
